info.title: Create Railways Navigator Web API
info.description: A Minecraft Create Mod addon that adds several new features related to train navigation, such as improved display boards, a navigator for searching routes, new schedule entries, and more.

All information about the mod, the running game instance and the loaded mod list.

Runs a route search between two stations and returns possible connection journeys. All times are in game ticks. A 200 response still carries a status that says whether journeys were found (OK) or why not (NO_ROUTE, NO_DIRECT_ROUTE, SAME_STATION or BACKEND_INACTIVE); an invalid query or an unknown station is reported as a 400 or 404 instead.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The station the journey ends at.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The station the journey starts at.

parameters.name: excluding_categories
parameters.description: Category ids the journey must avoid.

parameters.name: transfer_time
parameters.description: The least time to allow for a transfer, in ticks.

parameters.name: via
parameters.description: Waypoints the journey must pass through, in order. Repeat the parameter for each waypoint. Every value is a station name, optionally suffixed with ':<minStay>' (a minimum stay in ticks).

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The most journeys to return.

parameters.name: direct
parameters.description: Whether to accept only journeys that need no transfer.

parameters.name: optimization
parameters.description: How the found journeys are ordered.

parameters.name: departure_in
parameters.description: Earliest departure, given as a number of ticks from now.

parameters.name: only_categories
parameters.description: If set, the only category ids the journey may use.

parameters.name: avoid_stations
parameters.description: Names of stations the journey must not call at.

parameters.name: only_lines
parameters.description: If set, the only line ids the journey may use.

parameters.name: excluding_lines
parameters.description: Line ids the journey must avoid.

400.description: A required parameter is missing or empty, or a parameter could not be parsed.

404.description: A station named in the query (origin, destination or a waypoint) does not exist.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields that should be included in the response. Omitted fields are dropped. A nested field is written as 'parent.child'. When this parameter is set, only the listed fields plus the ones the server always includes are returned, so a field otherwise marked as required in the schema may be missing.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Comma-separated list of fields by which the array response should be sorted. Add the prefix '-' for descending order.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of items to return from an array response.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Amount of items to skip from the start of an array response.
